limitations: Road ribbon mesh tops and elevated bridges are not TerrainData. Bridge footprints are excluded from terrain-slope alarms.
Water segments are marked excluded and must be validated separately as bridges or layout gaps.
A 2m finite difference can smooth sharper triangle normals; no real-player pass is inferred.
Nearby buildings are spatial context; causal attribution requires checking generation order and grading footprints.
scope: Read-only actual saved TerrainData.sample() along road centers, both carriageway edges and both sidewalk centers, spacing <=2m. No city or Player instancing; not runtime traversal acceptance.
